name: Entity Reference Overflow
description: Allows entity-reference fields to display an "overflow" (e.g. show N items then a +more indicator).
project_description:
This module inserts entities into the output of an Entity Reference Field, in addition to the values that are set in the field. This can be helpful with creating "Related Content" sections that need to allow for both manual selection as well as a dynamic fallback.

 This module uses the configuration of the Entity Reference Field to determine where to pull additional content from.
